name: csa-loom-unity
description: CSA Loom Unity — self-hosted, Unity-Catalog-compatible metastore packaged for Azure Government (where Databricks Unity Catalog is unavailable/limited). Thin config-rendering overlay on the official unitycatalog/unitycatalog image, plus the Postgres JDBC driver and a dependency-free Entra authentication plugin; Entra-only PostgreSQL Flexible Server persistence by default (legacy H2 file DB as fallback), Entra bearer authorization on by default, optional ADLS credential vending. Azure-native, no Microsoft Fabric dependency.
